svg.title: Workspace evidence, Reservation and Check-in result
svg.desc: A local Workspace Manifest contains entries that pin documents and expected Generations with Checkout or Reference mode and digests. The server separately owns Logical Documents, Working Heads and Reservations. One Check-in Operation contains exact entries using Reservations and expected Generations; a committed changed entry can produce one immutable Generation, while a No Change entry produces none. The resource owner separately records its correlated Authorization Decision and Owner Command Outcome in the same relational unit of work as owner state, Audit Evidence and outbox.
